records.region: Northeast Greenland, Inland Ice and Dronning Louise Land, ending in the eastern land-margin and southern Storstrømmen–southwestern Dove Bugt setting.
records.candidate_name_role: Dronning Louise Land is land geography, Storstrømmen is contextual glacier/ice geography, and Dove Bugt is adjacent coastal-water geography. None is applied as a whole-river candidate.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: The actual original covers the complete selected terrain, including its inland-ice opening, exposed-rock and ice-margin passages across Dronning Louise Land, and eastern ice/coastal ending, but establishes no representative natural-river hydronym or surveyed continuous river. No material geographic interval remains unread at ordinary source scale.
records.completion_scope: Complete ordinary regional/corridor-scale geographic correspondence of the chosen opening, all selected parts and joins, ice/land passages and actual terminal setting. This is not proof of natural-river or hydraulic continuity.

records.region: Central Orinoco delta, eastern Venezuela, from the interior delta east of Caño Macareo northeastward to the Atlantic coastal opening beside Isla de Mariusa.
records.candidate_name_role: Representative identity for the mapped receiving corridor, based on the direct Caño Mariusa label on the independently compiled historical chart. The unnamed southwestern feeder remains a component with no separately established name; the candidate is not asserted as a uniform label for every selected reach.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected route is not the much broader Caño Macareo to the west. It follows a distinct interior feeder, a middle eastward dogleg and the north-northeastward Mariusa channel, ending at the opening southeast of Isla de Mariusa. The island, adjacent bars, lakes and other delta channels retain their own feature identities.
records.completion_scope: All21 stored parts of the single selected fragment were considered against original chart pixels, including the chosen southwestern opening, small-channel branching, middle dogleg and junction, broad lower reach, terminal west-side branch arrival and the actual final coastal tip. The original linework supports a continuous ordinary-scale corridor. This does not require every generalized model position to coincide with an exact bank or modern channel centerline. No substantial unviewed through-link remains in the selected route.
records.supported_name_scope: The selected thin southwestern delta channel joins the northeastward receiving waterway explicitly labeled Caño Mariusa, which continues to the coastal opening beside the southeastern end of Isla de Mariusa. The separate Macareo corridor to the west and Güiniquina/Araguabisi waterways to the east are distinguishable on the same source.

scope_limits: Caño Mariusa is a historically mapped representative receiving-corridor name, not a verified current registry entry or an assertion that every upper feeder has that name.
The upper selected feeder and exact natural hydronym boundaries remain unnamed; this does not create a geographical through-link gap because the selected connection is mapped.
The precise naming of the coastal barra/outlet and any alternate modern hydronyms are not established.
The chart is historical and generalized; current channel migration, tide direction, water levels, navigation and exact banks are unverified.
The modeled137.016km length is not an official published length for Caño Mariusa.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
